name: CON-01 One field at a time without re-asking
expected_outcome: The agent asks for one missing contact field at a time and never re-asks a saved field. After the email it shows a complete summary with Dana Levi, 0501234567, and dana@example.com and asks whether all details are correct. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: CON-02 Bundled contacts without punctuation
expected_outcome: All three contacts are extracted from one space-separated message without asking again. The summary shows Dana Levi, 0501234567, and dana@example.com. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: CON-03 Invalid then international phone
expected_outcome: 050-12 is rejected with a brief expected-format hint and not saved. +972 50 123 4567 is saved as 0501234567. The name is not requested again. The summary shows 0501234567. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: CON-04 Email domain typo asks before saving
expected_outcome: The agent does not silently save dana@gmial.com; it asks whether the applicant meant dana@gmail.com. After yes, the summary shows dana@gmail.com. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: CON-05 Valid contacts are not security-blocked
expected_outcome: The contact message is accepted, not blocked or refused as off-topic. The summary shows yanai klugman, 0531234567, and me@yanai.sh. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.
